_readme: Objects the user tracks that fall outside OpenNGC's NGC/IC scope entirely (Sharpless HII regions, Lynds dark nebulae). build_catalogue.py merges these into the generated catalogue after the OpenNGC pass. Every field must trace to a citable source recorded in '_source' below it — do not add an entry here without one. '_source' keys are stripped before the object is written to dso_catalog_extended.json.

_source.size: VizieR VII/20 (Sharpless, S. 1959, ApJS 4, 257, 'Catalogue of HII Regions'), row Sh2=142, Diam(arcmin)=30, retrieved 2026-07-30.
_source.type: SIMBAD object type for SH 2-142 is 'HII' (an HII region is by definition an emitter) -> emission_nebula. Unambiguous, unlike OpenNGC's generic 'Neb' rows.
_source.magnitude: No value in any SIMBAD flux band (Flux/Angular-size rows blank for this object). Integrated magnitude is not well-defined for a diffuse HII region — not an omission.
_source.note: SIMBAD lists 'NAME Wizard Nebula' as an identifier of this same SH 2-142 record, i.e. it treats Sh2-142 as the surrounding HII region of the NGC7380 cluster/nebula already in the base catalogue. The two ids are kept as separate catalogue rows (matching the user's target list, which tracks them separately) but their positions are ~8' apart, not identical — this is not a duplicate entry.

_source.position: SIMBAD (simbad.u-strasbg.fr), object 'LDN 1625', Coordinates(ICRS,ep=J2000,eq=2000) = 06 27 42.0 +05 58 00, retrieved 2026-07-30. Cross-checked against VizieR VII/7A (Lynds, B.T. 1962, ApJS 7, 1, 'Catalogue of Dark Nebulae'), row LDN=1625, computed columns _RA.icrs/_DE.icrs = 06 27 40.7 +05 58 05 (agrees to ~2 arcsec).
_source.size: SIMBAD measured angular size 264' (source 2002A&A...383..631D, Dutra & Bica 2002), retrieved 2026-07-30. Consistent with VizieR VII/7A's cataloged Area = 19.400 deg2, whose circular-equivalent diameter (2*sqrt(area/pi)) is ~298' — same order, non-circular cloud shape accounts for the difference.
_source.type: SIMBAD object type 'DNe' (dark nebula) -> mapped to 'other'. The vocabulary has no dark-nebula equivalent and it is an absorption feature, not an emitter — same reasoning applied to OpenNGC's own 'DrkN' rows (see build_catalogue.py TYPE_MAP).
_source.magnitude: No value in any SIMBAD flux band. Integrated magnitude is not defined for an absorption (dark) nebula — not an omission.
